jobs.title: Financial Controller - Bermuda
jobs.description:
You desire impactful work.

You’re RGA ready

RGA is a purpose-driven organization working to solve today’s challenges through innovation and collaboration. A Fortune 200 Company and listed among its World’s Most Admired Companies , we’re the only global reinsurance company to focus primarily on life- and health-related solutions. Join our multinational team of intelligent, motivated, and collaborative people, and help us make financial protection accessible to all.

A Brief Overview

Reporting directly to the Bermuda Chief Financial Officer, the Financial Controller – Bermuda Operations is responsible for leading legal entity financial reporting, statutory reporting, regulatory reporting, internal control oversight, audit coordination, and management and Board reporting for RGA's Bermuda operations. The role ensures timely, accurate and well-controlled reporting under applicable GAAP, Bermuda statutory, regulatory and internal management requirements, while partnering with local and global Finance, Actuarial, Risk, Compliance, Tax, Treasury and business stakeholders. The position also supports finance transformation, process improvement, governance, and other strategic finance projects aligned with RGA's global standards and Bermuda regulatory expectations.

What you will do
- Statutory and Regulatory Reporting: Lead preparation, review and coordination of annual and quarterly materials required for submissions to the Bermuda Monetary Authority, Registrar of Companies and other applicable regulatory or governmental bodies. Including Bermuda Statutory Financial Statements, Economic Balance Sheet, BSCR model, FCR, QFRs, Economic Substance Return and associated materials.
- Financial Reporting and Close: Working with the Legal Entity Reporting & Compliance team, review of the annual and quarterly US GAAP financial statements process for assigned Bermuda legal entities, including reporting, analytical reviews, variance analysis and supporting schedules.
- Board and Management Reporting: Prepare, review and deliver clear, accurate and insightful financial reporting packages, management reports, Board materials and committee papers for senior leadership, entity management and Boards of Directors of RGA’s Bermuda registered legal entities.
- Internal Controls and Governance: Oversee and strengthen internal controls over financial reporting, including design, documentation, execution, review and remediation of controls consistent with RGA enterprise standards, applicable accounting requirements and Bermuda governance expectations.
- Audit Management: Assist with coordination and management of external audit activities for assigned entities, including audit planning, information requests, issue resolution, management representation support, statutory audit deliverables and timely completion of audited financial statements.
- Stakeholder Coordination: Work closely with local and global Legal Entity Reporting & Compliance, Actuarial, Investments, Investment Accounting, Risk, Compliance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Structured Finance, Internal Audit and other relevant business teams to ensure consistent reporting, complete documentation, timely issue escalation and effective resolution of technical accounting, statutory, regulatory and operational matters.
- Finance Projects and Process Improvement: Lead or support finance projects, including reporting enhancements, control improvements, system or process changes, new business or transaction support, regulatory change implementation and other initiatives supporting the Bermuda finance operating model.
- People and Team Leadership: Provide direction, coaching and review support to finance team members and cross-functional contributors, promoting accountability, collaboration, technical quality, continuous improvement and a strong control mindset.
- Other Duties: Maintain regular and predictable attendance, keep abreast of relevant accounting, regulatory and industry developments, and perform other duties as assigned.

Required Skills:
- Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration or related field.
- Professional accounting qualifications, such as CPA, CA, ACCA or equivalent.
- 7+ years of combined post-qualification public accounting, insurance/reinsurance accounting, audit, financial reporting, statutory reporting or legal entity reporting experience.
- 5+ years of prior regulatory reporting experience within the Bermuda insurance or reinsurance industry, including familiarity with Bermuda Monetary Authority reporting requirements, statutory financial statements, BSCR, FCR, CISSA and related reporting frameworks.
- 3+ years’ experience working in a financial reporting role at a Bermuda-registered Class D or Class E Long Term Insurer or Reinsurer.
- Demonstrated experience preparing and/or reviewing quarterly Board, management, regulatory or senior leadership reporting materials.
- Working knowledge of internal control frameworks over financial reporting, including control documentation, evidence standards, review procedures and remediation tracking.
- Advanced knowledge of accounting, financial reporting, statutory reporting, legal entity reporting, analytical review, and variance explanation concepts.
- Advanced knowledge of Bermuda Monetary Authority requirements for a Bermuda insurer or reinsurer, including statutory financial statements, BSCR, FCR, CISSA, LLSBA and related reporting frameworks.
- Strong risk and control mindset, with the ability to identify reporting risks, design or improve controls, evaluate evidence and drive remediation.
- Advanced analytical, investigative and problem-solving skills, including ability to interpret complex data and translate findings into clear conclusions and action plans.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare Board-ready and senior-management-ready materials.
- Ability to build effective relationships and influence stakeholders across local, regional and global teams.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, stakeholders, and deliverables in a dynamic regulated environment.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, completeness, documentation quality, and audit readiness.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Excel (including advanced formula usage), Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams and OneDrive.
- Experience with PeopleSoft, OneStream, Workiva, Power BI or similar general ledger, consolidation, reporting or workflow tools.
- Demonstrated accountability, professional judgment, integrity, and ability to maintain confidentiality.

Preferred Skills:

- Master’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration or related field.
- Familiarity with SOX controls frameworks as applied to financial reporting.
- Experience leading finance projects, reporting transformation, control enhancement initiatives or cross-functional process improvements.
- Prior people management or team leadership experience.
- Experience of reporting to and presenting at Board or Senior Executive and management meetings on financial reporting matters.
- Knowledge of life, health, or annuity insurance products.
- Knowledge of BMA’s Scenario-Based-Approach (SBA) methodology and reporting requirements.
- Understanding of Bermuda’s Economic Substance rules and requirements.

- Collaborate with stakeholders across business units and IT to define, implement and operationalize policies and standards for data management, data quality, metadata, data security, and privacy across the EDP ecosystem.

- Monitor compliance with data governance policies and standards through audits and metrics reporting across the EDP ecosystem.

- Creates, implements, and monitors effective metrics.

- Develops and maintains effective relationships; takes ownership for the relationships, ensuring organizational objectives are met.

- Communicates difficult concepts and negotiates with others to adopt a different point of view and drive innovation.

- Develop frameworks and models to classify data and define ownership, data quality, metadata management, lifecycle management, and access controls.

- Works in an Agile environment and continuously reviews the business needs, refines priorities, outlines milestones and deliverables, and identifies opportunities and risks.

- Performs capacity planning and creates technical diagrams and layouts.

- May lead cross-functional project teams to drive adoption of data governance standards by educating stakeholders on policies, procedures, and best practices and/or implement new security and compliance standards across various RGA teams.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (BA/BS) or equivalent education/ experience
- 10+ Years of progressive experience in enterprise-level data governance, data management or related field demonstrating in depth expertise in own specialized discipline or field as well as basic knowledge of related disciplines
- 4+ Years of experience in managing enterprise initiatives, teams, and engineering solutions; demonstrated skill aligning solutions with business goals and objectives

Skills and Abilities:

- Strong knowledge of data governance frameworks, policies, standards programs and their practical implementation within data platforms.
- Knowledge of data privacy, security, lifecycle management, and data quality best practices
- Experience defining data policies, procedures, standards, and guidelines
- Experience implementing and managing enterprise data catalog capabilities and applying governance requirements through operational platform controls, metadata management, stewardship, lineage, and data quality processes. Demonstrated ability to lead teams and projects
- Advanced ability to lead and resolve complex problems, working across broad groups and geographies
- Advanced interpersonal skills, including the ability to build consensus
- Advanced communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex or difficult information
- Balance of technical knowledge and business acumen
- Customer first, service-oriented thinking and mind set
- Proactive, self-starter with excellent project management skills and ability to manage multiple tasks effectively
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage, influence, and inspire partners and stakeholders to drive collaboration and alignment
- High degree of organization, individual initiative, and personal accountability

#LI-MJ1  #LI-REMOTE

What you can expect from RGA:
- Gain valuable knowledge from and experience with diverse, caring colleagues around the world.

- Enjoy a respectful, welcoming environment that fosters individuality and encourages pioneering thought.

- Join the bright and creative minds of RGA, and experience vast, endless career potential.

We’re excited to get to know you and connect your unique skills with our global opportunities. This technology helps us personalize job recommendations, automate interview scheduling, evaluate candidates based solely on experience—without considering name, gender, or other personal details—and provide real-time answers through our chatbot. Base pay varies depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and market location. jobs.title: Associate Director, Business Development
jobs.description:
You desire impactful work.

You’re RGA ready

RGA is a purpose-driven organization working to solve today’s challenges through innovation and collaboration. A Fortune 200 Company and listed among its World’s Most Admired Companies , we’re the only global reinsurance company to focus primarily on life- and health-related solutions. Join our multinational team of intelligent, motivated, and collaborative people, and help us make financial protection accessible to all.

Position overview
A key member of the Business Development team to achieve RGA's financial target, create new business opportunity through driving new propositions and working closely with Pricing, Investment Solutions, Marketing & Transaction Services (MTS) and Treaty teams.  The candidate will also dual hat as a key member of the Corporate Development team to drive strategic initiatives to accelerate RGA’s growth in APAC.

Responsibilities
- Develop a good understanding of RGA’s risk appetite and pricing frameworks to facilitate development of executable reinsurance solutions that contribute to RGA’s success

- Structure solutions that satisfy RGA’s risk and pricing frameworks

- Drive and prioritize reinsurance quotations, and proactively project manage client requests

- Liaise internally across teams to ensure the company’s deliverables are meeting client’s needs and satisfying RGA’s service standards

- Establish strong working relationships with clients of RGA including senior executive decision makers

- Negotiate on behalf of RGA and to manage multiple projects as well as reinsurance quotations

- Perform research and analyze latest marketing/product trends in Japan market, present results internally and externally and identify opportunities or innovative solutions

- Develop a good understanding of Japan accounting, solvency & capital and other relevant regulations

- Create marketing materials (e.g. presentation and proposals etc.) and manage RGA intellectual capital (e.g. template updates)

- Represent RGA in industry events and speak at client events and seminars

- Lead cross-functional project teams or assist in project work including establishing internal reports, analyzing profitability of existing treaty lines and business case proposals

- Provide guidance to other team members and assist to build and manage a strong Business Development team for both Financial Solutions and Traditional businesses

- Support Executive Director, Business Development on other business matters and tasks as and when required

- Support Vice President, Corporate Development APAC on strategic initiatives RGA will assess and execute, including M&As, strategic partnerships and associated reinsurance transactions

- Conduct research and develop a good understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities, analyze potential targets and potential partners’ strategic priorities, devise strategic partnership and transaction frameworks, and assess how value can be created through partnership with RGA

- Create and present strategic discussion materials for potential partners and internal stakeholders

- Work closely with internal stakeholders and external advisors to execute strategic transactions

Requirements
- Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (BA/BS) in in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance or related disciplines

- 10+ years' experience in a life insurance, insurance consulting or reinsurance company, experience in product development or pricing

- 5 years' reinsurance experience with exposure to client facing work (marketing, business development) or with significant exposure to reinsurance as part of the job

- Financial institutions and/or investment banking experience is preferred

- Actuarial qualification or equivalent is preferred

- Excellent communication skills in Japanese and English (both written and verbal is preferred) with the ability to communicate difficult concepts and negotiate with others to adopt a different point of view

- Strong critical and innovative thinking, with the ability to develop business insights, resolve complex problems and deliver solutions as well as recommendations is preferred

- Highly motivated, results oriented and solutions focused

- Excellent project management skills and ability to partner with internal & external stakeholders in a collaborative manner

What you can expect from RGA:
